artifact:
Feature: Alarms and Temperature Monitoring

  Scenario: Battery failure alarm has high priority
    Given the system is initialized
    When a battery failure is detected
    Then the "battery failure" alarm should be triggered with high priority

  Scenario: System senses temperature of heating elements
    Given the system is initialized
    When the system is in operation
    Then the temperature of the blower motor should be sensed
    And the temperature of the battery cell should be sensed

  Scenario: GUI reads temperature sensors
    Given the system is initialized
    When the system is in operation
    Then the GUI should display the temperature of the blower motor
    And the GUI should display the temperature of the blower power management system
    And the GUI should display the temperature of the battery cell

  Scenario: Blower motor temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower motor exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: Blower power system temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower power management system exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: Battery temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the battery cell exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: Safety action on blower power system temperature too high
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower power management system exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the safety action specified for this condition should be invoked

  Scenario: Safety action on battery temperature too high
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the battery cell exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the safety action specified for this condition should be invoked

  Scenario Outline: Verify displayed temperature values match sensor readings
    Given the system is initialized
    When the system is in operation
    And the temperature of the <sensor> is set to <value>
    Then the GUI should display the temperature of the <sensor> as <value>
    Examples:
      | sensor                | value |
      | blower motor          | 25    |
      | blower power management | 30    |
      | battery cell          | 40    |

  Scenario Outline: Test priority levels for other alarms
    Given the system is initialized
    When a <alarm> is triggered
    Then the alarm should have the priority level specified in the requirements
    Examples:
      | alarm                 | priority level |
      | battery failure       | high           |
      | blower motor temperature too high | medium |
      | blower power system temperature too high | high |
      | battery temperature too high | high |
